flashcards.back: Ancient: Krishna taught it to Vivasvan, who passed it to Manu, then Ikshvaku and the saintly kings. When it was lost, he taught it again to Arjuna.
Whenever Dharma declines and Adharma prevails: to protect the good, transform the wicked and establish world order.

flashcards.front: What does understanding God's birth and deeds bring?
flashcards.back: Liberation: one who truly knows them is not born again after leaving the body.
According to their motive. People seek him for different ends, and each is met on their own path.
Created by God by aptitude and vocation; yet he is the non-doer and eternal.

flashcards.front: Why does Karma not bind God?
flashcards.back: He has no desire for the fruits of work. Whoever knows and lives this is not bound either.
One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise: a yogi who has done everything.
One content, unattached to fruits and dependent only on God does nothing at all, though active, and incurs no Karmic reaction.
God is realized by one who sees everything as a manifestation or an act of God.
Worship, study, sense restraint, breath control, charity and more: practised selflessly, each purifies.
Gaining and sharing Self-knowledge is above any material gift: all actions culminate in knowledge.
From a Self-realized teacher, approached with humility, sincere questions and service.
As fire turns wood to ash, Self-knowledge burns away all Karma; even the worst sinner crosses on its raft.
One with faith, sincere practice and control of the senses. The faithless and doubting do not.
Cut the doubt in your heart with the sword of Self-knowledge, take up Karma-yoga, and rise to act.
Those who serve selflessly gain the nectar of Self-knowledge and reach the Eternal. Even this world is unhappy for the non-sacrificer.

quiz.text: When does God manifest, according to 4.7-8?
quiz.why: To protect the good, transform the wicked and establish Dharma.

quiz.text: To whom did Krishna first teach this yoga?
quiz.why: Vivasvan to Manu to Ikshvaku: the line of saintly kings.

quiz.text: How does God respond to different worshippers?
quiz.why: Each is met on the path and with the motive they bring.

options.B: One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction

quiz.why: Selfless work leaves no Karma: inaction in action.

quiz.text: Why does the Karma-yogi incur no Karmic reaction?

options.A: He is unattached to fruits and content

quiz.why: 4.20: active, yet doing nothing, because attachment is gone.

quiz.text: What is superior to any material gift (4.33)?

options.C: From a realized teacher, with humility and service

quiz.why: Approach the teacher humbly, ask sincerely, serve.

quiz.text: What does the fire of knowledge burn?
quiz.why: Like fire to wood: even the most sinful cross over.

quiz.text: With what does Krishna tell Arjuna to cut doubt?
quiz.why: Destroy the doubt, take up Karma-yoga, and stand up.
